name: directions_annot_clear
title: R3 mean-difference steering directions (annotation sidestep)
description: 96 unit directions (32 layers x {cycle, loop, muse}): mean(healthy controls) - mean(class onsets), conf=clear. Sign convention: direction points from divergence toward healthy. Keys dir_<class>_L<layer>, metadata json with n_pos/n_neg/auroc. These are the constant-lambda fixed-direction baselines TERMINAL_FORK_COMPUTE constraint 7 requires a controller to beat.
caveats: Derived from observational probes; advisory until fork-validated (detector nominates, forks ratify).
